name: Jamba 1.5 Large
description: Hybrid SSM-Transformer model with 256K context at exceptional speed.
longDescription: Jamba 1.5 Large is a 94B parameter model using a novel hybrid SSM-Transformer architecture (Mamba + Attention). This unique design delivers a massive 256K context window with exceptional inference speed and efficiency, outperforming traditional transformers on long-context tasks.

codeSnippets.code:
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    base_url="https://api.ai21.com/studio/v1",
    api_key="YOUR_AI21_API_KEY"
)
response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="jamba-1.5-large",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)
